question: Auditoria: quantas internacoes tem vinculo previdenciario sem correspondencia na dimensao?
generated_sql: WITH base AS ( SELECT i.VINCPREV FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN vincprev v ON i.VINCPREV = v.VINCPREV ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS qt_internacoes_sem_correspondencia FROM base WHERE VINCPREV IS NOT NULL AND VINCPREV <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vincprev v WHERE v.VINCPREV = base.VINCPREV );

question: Como a tabela de staging se distribui por carater de internacao?

question: Quantos hospitais existem por UF do municipio do hospital?
generated_sql: WITH hospitais_por_municipio AS ( SELECT h.MUNIC_MOV, COUNT(DISTINCT h.CNES) AS qt_hospitais FROM hospital h WHERE h.MUNIC_MOV IS NOT NULL GROUP BY h.MUNIC_MOV ) SELECT m.SG_UF AS uf, SUM(hpm.qt_hospitais) AS qt_hospitais FROM hospitais_por_municipio hpm JOIN municipios m ON m.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D = hpm.MUNIC_MOV GROUP BY m.SG_UF ORDER BY qt_hospitais DESC, uf;

question: Qual populacao socioeconomica existe por UF e ano quando ha denominador socioeconomico?
generated_sql: WITH base AS ( SELECT m.SG_UF, s.NU_ANO, s.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D, s.QT_POPULACAO FROM socioeconomico s JOIN municipios m ON m.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D = s.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D WHERE s.QT_POPULACAO IS NOT NULL ), uf_ano AS ( SELECT SG_UF, NU_ANO AS ano, SUM(QT_POPULACAO) AS populacao_socioeconomica FROM base GROUP BY SG_UF, NU_ANO ) SELECT SG_UF, ano, populacao_socioeconomica FROM uf_ano ORDER BY SG_UF, ano;

question: Quantas mortes hospitalares com diagnostico principal CID C ocorreram por ano?
generated_sql: WITH mortes_cid_c AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) AS ano, COUNT(*) AS mortes_hospitalares FROM internacoes i WHERE i.MORTE = TRUE AND i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C%' GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT ano, mortes_hospitalares FROM mortes_cid_c ORDER BY ano;

question: Qual e a taxa de mortalidade hospitalar por sexo?
generated_sql: WITH base AS ( SELECT i.SEXO, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i.MORTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS obitos FROM internacoes i GROUP BY i.SEXO ) SELECT s.DESCRICAO AS sexo, b.total_internacoes, b.obitos, 100.0 * b.obitos / NULLIF(b.total_internacoes, 0) AS taxa_mortalidade_hospitalar FROM base b LEFT JOIN sexo s ON b.SEXO = s.SEXO ORDER BY taxa_mortalidade_hospitalar DESC, sexo;

question: Quais UFs e sexos tiveram mais internacoes por residencia mapeada?
generated_sql: WITH base AS ( SELECT m.SG_UF AS uf, s.DESCRICAO AS sexo, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios m ON i.MUNIC_RES = m.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D LEFT JOIN sexo s ON i.SEXO = s.SEXO WHERE i.MUNIC_RES IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.SG_UF, s.DESCRICAO ), ranked AS ( SELECT uf, sexo, total_internacoes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC, uf, sexo) AS rn FROM base ) SELECT uf, sexo, total_internacoes FROM ranked ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC, uf, sexo;

question: Qual e o mix de complexidade por carater de internacao?
generated_sql: WITH base AS ( SELECT ci.DESCRICAO AS carater_internacao, co.DESCRICAO AS complexidade, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN car_int ci ON i.CAR_INT = ci.CAR_INT LEFT JOIN complexidade co ON i.COMPLEX = co.COMPLEX WHERE i.CAR_INT IS NOT NULL AND i.COMPLEX IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ), calc AS ( SELECT carater_internacao, complexidade, total_internacoes, SUM(total_internacoes) OVER (PARTITION BY carater_internacao) AS total_por_carater FROM base ) SELECT carater_internacao, complexidade, total_internacoes, ROUND(100.0 * total_internacoes / total_por_carater, 2) AS pct_mix FROM calc ORDER BY carater_internacao, total_internacoes DESC, complexidade;
